records.source: IT IS NOT A FALLBACK, IT IS THE BETTER CHANNEL. The tile axis on DAPI peaks at 23 to 85; this peaks at 169 to 281. Spots are punctate and abundant and nuclei are smooth and few, so losing the Hoechst costs nothing here.
records.context: It is not a fallback, it is the better image data channel. The tile axis on DAPI peaks at 23 to 85; this peaks at 169 to 281. Spots are punctate and abundant and nuclei are smooth and few, so losing the Hoechst costs nothing here.
records.translation: 这不是退而求其次，而是更好的通道。 DAPI 上的拼图轴峰值为 23 到 85；这里则是 169 到 281。斑点是点状且数量众多的，而细胞核平滑且稀少，所以在这里失去 Hoechst 没有任何代价。
